null: cluster maxima over real database chains, same Rfam family or clan excluded; nothing censored
note: Gumbel (mu, beta) of the cluster-max null on a grid of query lengths, interpolated by evalue.clustermax_params_for_length. E = N_clusters * (1 - exp(-exp(-(S - mu)/beta))); the bit score is (S - mu)/(beta ln 2). Fitting maxima rather than individual pairs removes the per-database censoring fraction the earlier chain-level calibration needed, and keeps the calibration stable across databases of different redundancy.

empirical_calibration.weighting: equal-family, equal-query-within-family; scaled to target cluster count
empirical_calibration.tm_score_definition: mean of query- and target-normalized US-align TM-scores
